title: Dynamics 365 Sales: Sales agent as the agentic home for sellers
summary: The briefing distinguishes the planned home from the existing Sales agent experience and accurately reports the roadmap targets, licensing and access requirements. The cited Learn pages opened successfully; two paths should be extended to reach the final setting.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans a Sales agent home that sellers can land in when opening Dynamics 365 Sales instead of a dashboard.
claims.quote: When sellers open Dynamics 365 Sales, they can land in Sales agent: an agentic home for all sales AI instead of a traditional dashboard.

claims.claim: The planned home brings agent recommendations and customer-engagement preparation together through structured workflows.
claims.quote: Structured workflows in Sales agent bring agent recommendations and customer-engagement preparation together

claims.claim: Learn identifies the existing embedded Sales agent capability in Dynamics 365 as preview.
claims.quote: The following capabilities are in preview: ... Sales agent is also accessible in Microsoft 365 Copilot within Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and Dynamics 365.

claims.claim: Accessing the existing Sales agent in Dynamics 365 requires an administrator to enable Microsoft 365 Copilot in model-driven apps.
claims.quote: Sales agent is accessible in Dynamics 365 only if your administrator has enabled Microsoft 365 Copilot in model-driven apps.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance; Open questions
claims.claim: The current embedded experience in Dynamics 365 does not expose meeting preparation features.
claims.quote: only conversational chat capabilities are available in these embedded experiences. Meeting preparation features aren't accessible in these locations.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: Sales agent reads CRM information based on the tables configured in its administrator settings.
claims.quote: The Sales agent accesses CRM information based on the CRM entities configured in Sales agent admin settings. In Dynamics 365, these entities are tables.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Adding an entity gives Sales agent access to all its columns, subject to the user's security privileges.
claims.quote: Sales agent will have access to all columns in the added entities (tables in Dynamics 365 or objects in Salesforce).

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Microsoft Graph grounding supplies email and meeting context to Sales agent.
claims.quote: Microsoft 365 Graph grounded data includes Outlook emails, Teams meetings, Teams messages, and people information stored in Microsoft Graph.

claims.claim: Sales agent only surfaces information that the user has permission to access.
claims.quote: Sales agent only surfaces information you have permission to access. Results depend on the data available in your Microsoft 365 environment.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Why it matters
claims.claim: Tenant access settings do not grant CRM data access or override licensing, environment or security requirements.
claims.quote: Tenant access settings don't grant access to CRM data and don't override licensing, environment, or security requirements.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Why it matters
claims.claim: Assigned CRM security roles and privileges bound access to environments, records, tables and fields.
claims.quote: Users can access only the CRM environments, records, tables, and fields permitted by their assigned security roles and privileges.

claims.claim: Auto-installed users are blocked by default in Microsoft 365 Copilot, the Sales pane in Outlook and Teams.
claims.quote: Microsoft 365 Copilot | Auto-installed users are blocked. Other eligible users have access. ... Sales pane in Outlook | Auto-installed users are blocked. ... Teams | Auto-installed users are blocked.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance controls
claims.claim: The Dynamics 365 access setting defaults to all eligible users having access, with Microsoft 365 Copilot in Dynamics 365 also needing enablement.
claims.quote: Dynamics 365 | All eligible users have access. Microsoft 365 Copilot in Dynamics 365 must also be turned on.

claims.claim: Blocked users in Dynamics 365 see an administrator-disabled message in the enabled Sales agent experience.
claims.quote: Dynamics 365 | Sales agent remains available in Microsoft Copilot in Dynamics 365, if enabled, but displays an administrator-disabled message.

claims.claim: The existing Sales agent in Dynamics 365 requires Copilot enablement for both the environment and app module.
claims.quote: The Sales agent is available in Dynamics 365 only when Microsoft 365 Copilot is enabled for the environment and app module.

claims.claim: Automatic installation alone does not make Sales agent available in Dynamics 365.
claims.quote: Automatic installation alone doesn't make the Sales agent available in Dynamics 365.

claims.claim: Sales agent uses Dataverse search to query Dynamics 365 CRM data.
claims.quote: For Dynamics 365, Sales agent uses Dataverse search to query CRM data.

claims.claim: Enabling Dataverse search can increase storage usage because searchable tables are indexed.
claims.quote: Enabling Dataverse search can increase storage usage because indexes are created for searchable tables.

claims.claim: The licensing model is mixed: basic Sales agent features are included in specified Sales licences, while premium features require Microsoft 365 Copilot.
claims.quote: Sales Enterprise, Sales Premium, and Microsoft Relationship Sales licenses include the basic features of Sales agent. To use the premium features, you must buy the Microsoft 365 Copilot license.

claims.claim: The Dynamics 365 Sales agent access control is reached in Teams through Sales > Settings > Tenant > Access settings > Allow access to Sales agent > Dynamics 365.
claims.quote: Under Tenant, select Access settings. ... Select Allow access to Sales agent. ... Dynamics 365: Allows access to the Sales agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot in Dynamics 365.

claims.claim: Environment Copilot availability is managed through Power Platform admin center > Copilot > Settings > Power Apps > Chat Agent > Microsoft Copilot > environment > Edit Setting.
claims.quote: go to Copilot > Settings. Under Power Apps, expand Chat Agent and choose Microsoft Copilot. ... Select an environment group or an environment name, then select Edit Setting. ... Select On
claims.fix: Extend controls[2].ui.path and the matching rendered path to 'Copilot > Settings > Power Apps > Chat Agent > Microsoft Copilot > environment > Edit Setting > On', as documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/power-apps/maker/model-driven-apps/add-microsoft-365-copilot.

claims.claim: CRM tables are added through Microsoft Teams > Sales > Settings > Features > Sales Chat > Add.
claims.quote: Open the Sales agent administrator settings. ... Under Features, select Sales Chat. ... Select Add.

claims.claim: Tenant access settings require Global Administrator, Exchange Administrator or Power Platform Administrator.
claims.quote: You must have one of the following Microsoft Entra roles: Global Administrator; Exchange Administrator; Power Platform Administrator

claims.claim: Dynamics 365 administrator settings require System Administrator or System Customizer, with additional privileges potentially needed for custom security roles.
claims.quote: Dynamics 365: You must have the System Administrator or System Customizer role. If you're using a custom security role, you might need more privileges to use the Sales agent.

claims.claim: Power Platform admin center > Copilot > Settings is the starting page for checking environment Copilot enablement.
claims.quote: In the navigation pane, go to Copilot > Settings. Under Power Apps, expand Chat Agent and choose Microsoft Copilot.
claims.fix: Replace the parenthetical path with 'Power Platform admin center > Copilot > Settings > Power Apps > Chat Agent > Microsoft Copilot > environment > Edit Setting', which reaches the setting to inspect.

claims.claim: An administrator can restrict Dynamics 365 access to pilot security groups by expanding the app, selecting Who can use this feature? > Set access restrictions and adding groups under Allow access.
claims.quote: expand the application and, under Who can use this feature? ... Set access restrictions: Use Microsoft Entra security groups to control access. ... Allow access: Search for and add security groups whose members can use Sales agent.

claims.claim: Access setting changes can take up to 15 minutes to take effect.
claims.quote: Access setting changes can take up to 15 minutes to take effect.

claims.claim: Microsoft Entra security group membership changes can take up to one hour to appear in access evaluations.
claims.quote: Microsoft Entra security group membership changes can take up to one hour to appear in access evaluations.
